name: Centipaar Insect Parts
summary: Centipaar Insect Parts are gathered from silithid in Tanaris's Noxious Lair. Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan studies them to learn more about the creatures draining the area's water pools.

sections.title: Parts from the Lair
sections.body: The Centipaar silithid in Noxious Lair yield parts for Alchemist Pestlezugg's investigation. He studies them in Gadgetzan, seeking to learn what these creatures are.

faq.answer: Centipaar Insect Parts are pieces gathered from silithid in Tanaris's Noxious Lair for Alchemist Pestlezugg to study.

faq.q: Where do I get Centipaar Insect Parts?
faq.answer: The Centipaar silithid in Noxious Lair yield the parts Alchemist Pestlezugg seeks.
Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan wants Centipaar Insect Parts so he can study the creatures from Noxious Lair.

faq.q: Why are the bugs being investigated?
faq.answer: The silithid are draining the water pools that once lay where Noxious Lair now stands, and Pestlezugg wants to learn what they are.
